atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predict Length", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
hl = high - low
hc = abs(high - close[1])
lc = abs(low - close[1])
tmpMax = hl > hc ? hl : hc
tr = tmpMax > lc ? tmpMax : lc
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
atrHigh = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
rngHigh = highest(rng, coilLookback)
atrCoil = atrVal / (atrHigh + 0.000001)
rngCoil = rng / (rngHigh + 0.000001)
coilLoad = (atrCoil + rngCoil) / 2.0
loadedness = 1.0 - coilLoad
atrMean = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / (atrMean + 0.000001)
disp = abs(close - close[predictLen])
sumTR = sma(tr, predictLen) * predictLen
eff = disp / (sumTR + 0.000001)
effMed = median(eff, coilLookback)
loadedRecent = highest(loadedness, 5) > 0.65
atrRising = atrVal > atrVal[1]
expansion = rng > releaseMult * atrVal
releaseTrig = expansion and atrRising and loadedRecent and bar_index > coilLookback
releaseEdge = releaseTrig and not releaseTrig[1]
buySig = releaseEdge and close > open and eff > effMed
sellSig = releaseEdge and close < open and eff > effMed
neutSig = releaseEdge and eff <= effMed
isPred = eff > effMed
loadPred = isPred ? loadedness : 0.0
loadUnpred = isPred ? 0.0 : loadedness
vovHeight = vov * (1.0 + loadedness) * 10.0
if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if neutSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Neutral", "x", "#ffd43b") }
if releaseEdge { bgcolor("#3a2f00") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if neutSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Neutral", "diamond", "#ffd43b", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
plot(loadedness, "Loadedness", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(eff, "Efficiency", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(vov, "VoV", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(loadPred, "Loaded Predictable", "scatter", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(loadUnpred, "Loaded Unpredictable", "scatter", "#ff9044", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovHeight, "VoV Height", "bars3d", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length Bars", 5, 200, 1)
htfLook = input(3, "1H Confirmation Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
confBars = input(2, "Structure Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
stopTicks = input(5, "Stop Offset Ticks", 1, 50, 1)
minConf = input(60, "Min Confidence", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2

hHigh = security("1h", high)
hLow = security("1h", low)
hClose = security("1h", close)

hSwingHigh = highest(hHigh, htfLook)
hSwingLow = lowest(hLow, htfLook)
priorSwingHigh = hSwingHigh[1]
priorSwingLow = hSwingLow[1]

bullBreak = hClose > priorSwingHigh
bearBreak = hClose < priorSwingLow

var bullCount = 0
var bearCount = 0
var pos = 0

bullCount := bullBreak ? bullCount[1] + 1 : 0
bearCount := bearBreak ? bearCount[1] + 1 : 0

bullConf = bullBreak and bullCount >= confBars
bearConf = bearBreak and bearCount >= confBars

displacement = abs(hClose - hClose[1])
priorRange = hHigh[1] - hLow[1]
dispOk = displacement > priorRange

noOppForBull = bearCount == 0
noOppForBear = bullCount == 0

alignBull = close > sessMid
alignBear = close < sessMid

bullScore = (dispOk ? 50 : 0) + (noOppForBull ? 25 : 0) + (alignBull ? 25 : 0)
bearScore = (dispOk ? 50 : 0) + (noOppForBear ? 25 : 0) + (alignBear ? 25 : 0)
conf = bullConf ? bullScore : bearConf ? bearScore : 0

stopOff = stopTicks * 0.1
stopLong = sessLow - stopOff
stopShort = sessHigh + stopOff

buySig = crossover(close, sessHigh[1]) and bullConf and conf >= minConf
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLow[1]) and bearConf and conf >= minConf
longStopHit = pos[1] == 1 and crossunder(close, stopLong)
shortStopHit = pos[1] == -1 and crossover(close, stopShort)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopLong, "abs")
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    pos := 1
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopShort, "abs")
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    pos := -1
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longStopHit {
    model.exit("siege")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
}
if shortStopHit {
    model.exit("siege")
    pos := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
}

curStop = pos == 1 ? stopLong : pos == -1 ? stopShort : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(curStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc33", 1, "stepline")

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
fib236Len = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
fib382Len = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
fib50Len = input(0.5, "Fib 50%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
fib618Len = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8%", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

fib236 = swingHigh - rng * fib236Len
fib382 = swingHigh - rng * fib382Len
fib50 = swingHigh - rng * fib50Len
fib618 = swingHigh - rng * fib618Len

var lastLbl = 0

buySig = close[1] < fib618[1] and close > fib618
sellSig = close[1] > fib382[1] and close < fib382

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fibEvt")
    if bar_index - lastLbl > 30 {
        label3d(bar_index, fib618, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 0.9, 3, "3d")
        lastLbl := bar_index
    }
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    text.new(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, "fibEvt")
    if bar_index - lastLbl > 30 {
        label3d(bar_index, fib382, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 0.9, 1, "3d")
        lastLbl := bar_index
    }
}

plot(fib236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(fib618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(fib236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(fib382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(fib50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(fib618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Length", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Length", 20, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Length", 40, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Range Length", 40, 100, 1)
compThresh = input(0.70, "Compression Ratio Threshold", 0.3, 0.95, 0.05)
expThresh = input(1.05, "Expansion Threshold", 0.8, 1.5, 0.05)
skewBull = input(0.60, "Skew Bullish Level", 0.5, 0.9, 0.05)
skewBear = input(0.40, "Skew Bearish Level", 0.1, 0.5, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
fastRV = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medRV = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowRV = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
rollHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
rollLow = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = rollHigh - rollLow + 0.000000001
skew = (close - rollLow) / rng
spreadFS = fastRV - slowRV
spreadFM = fastRV - medRV
compRatio = fastRV / (slowRV + 0.000000001)
compState = compRatio < compThresh
wasComp = compState[1]
compCrossUp = compRatio > expThresh and compRatio[1] <= expThresh
expandTrig = wasComp and fastRV > fastRV[1] and compCrossUp
skewBullCross = skew > skewBull and skew[1] <= skewBull
skewBearCross = skew < skewBear and skew[1] >= skewBear
spreadFlipUp = spreadFS > 0 and spreadFS[1] <= 0
spreadFlipDn = spreadFS < 0 and spreadFS[1] >= 0
warm = bar_index > slowLen
buySig = warm and expandTrig and skewBullCross and spreadFlipUp
sellSig = warm and expandTrig and skewBearCross and spreadFlipDn

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
  model.longEntry("SVBuy", 1)
}

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
  model.shortEntry("SVSell", 1)
}

plot(fastRV, "Fast RV", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(medRV, "Medium RV", "#3388ff", 1, "separate")
plot(slowRV, "Slow RV", "#ffaa22", 1, "separate")
plot(spreadFS, "Spread Fast-Slow", "#cc44ff", 2, "separate")
plot(spreadFM, "Spread Fast-Med", "#44ddcc", 1, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffdd44", 2, "separate")
plot(skewBull + r * 0.0001, "Skew Bull", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(skewBear + r * 0.0001, "Skew Bear", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(fastRV, "Term Fast", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(medRV, "Term Med Spine", "ribbon", "#3388ff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(slowRV, "Term Slow Impulse", "bars3d", "#ffaa22", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
maxScale = input(100, "Max Scale", 1, 200, 1)
thicknessBase = input(1, "Thickness Base", 0.5, 5, 0.5)
thicknessFactor = input(0.1, "Thickness Factor", 0, 1, 0.01)
buyLevel = input(70, "Buy Level", 0, 100, 1)
sellLevel = input(30, "Sell Level", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

micro = (close - open) * 100 / (close + 0.000001)
c1raw = ch1 + micro
c1 = c1raw < 0 ? 0 : c1raw > 100 ? 100 : c1raw
c2raw = ch2 + micro * 0.8
c2 = c2raw < 0 ? 0 : c2raw > 100 ? 100 : c2raw
c3raw = ch3 + micro * 0.6
c3 = c3raw < 0 ? 0 : c3raw > 100 ? 100 : c3raw
c4raw = ch4 + micro * 0.4
c4 = c4raw < 0 ? 0 : c4raw > 100 ? 100 : c4raw
c5raw = ch5 + micro * 0.2
c5 = c5raw < 0 ? 0 : c5raw > 100 ? 100 : c5raw
h1 = (c1 / maxScale) * 100
h2 = (c2 / maxScale) * 100
h3 = (c3 / maxScale) * 100
h4 = (c4 / maxScale) * 100
h5 = (c5 / maxScale) * 100
avg = (c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5) / 5
avgPrev = avg[1]
slope = h5 - h1
splineVal = (h1 + h2 * 2 + h3 * 2 + h4 * 2 + h5) / 7
curveThickness = thicknessBase + thicknessFactor * avg
zoneCol = avg < sellLevel ? "#ff4477" : avg > buyLevel ? "#22cc88" : "#ffcc33"
ch5Highest = c5 >= c1 and c5 >= c2 and c5 >= c3 and c5 >= c4
ch1Lowest = c1 <= c2 and c1 <= c3 and c1 <= c4 and c1 <= c5
buySig = avg > buyLevel and avg[1] <= buyLevel and ch5Highest
sellSig = avg < sellLevel and avg[1] >= sellLevel and ch1Lowest
avgChange = abs(avg - avgPrev)
alertSig = avgChange > 10 and ((avg > avgPrev and slope > 0) or (avg < avgPrev and slope < 0))

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 5, "separate")
}
if alertSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Alert", "diamond", "#ffcc33")
}

plot(h1, "Cyl1", "#33aaff", 1, "separate")
plot(h2, "Cyl2", "#33ccff", 1, "separate")
plot(h3, "Cyl3", "#33ddaa", 1, "separate")
plot(h4, "Cyl4", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(h5, "Cyl5", "#ff8833", 1, "separate")
plot(splineVal, "Spline", "#22cc88", curveThickness, "separate")
plot(avg, "Avg", "#ffffff", 2, "separate")
hline(buyLevel, "#22cc88", "separate")
hline(sellLevel, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(h1, "Cyl1", "bars3d", "#33aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(h2, "Cyl2", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(h3, "Cyl3", "bars3d", "#33ddaa", "separate", 2)
plot3d(h4, "Cyl4", "bars3d", "#ffcc33", "separate", 3)
plot3d(h5, "Cyl5", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 4)
plot3d(splineVal, "Spline", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 5)
